summary.text: Chris Anders is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates, representing District 97, who took office on December 1, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a political consultant who, in a Ballotpedia survey, described himself as a constitutional conservative and chair of the Freedom Caucus.

paragraphs.text: S. Chris Anders was born in Hagerstown, Maryland, and graduated from Boonsboro High School.

His professional experience includes working as a political consultant, and Ballotpedia lists affiliations with organizations including the National Association for Gun Rights, Young Americans for Liberty and Students for Life.
Anders succeeded John Hardy in District 97 and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.

In the 2026 survey, he listed the Bill of Rights, property rights, the Second and Fourth Amendments, medical liberty, defending life at conception and reducing the size and scope of government as his policy interests.
